name: Visitors of Piedmont forest, North Carolina
description: Spring wildflowers of a deciduous forest and their insect visitors, counted through the springs of 1977 to 1979 before the trees leaf out.

citation.text: Alexander F. Motten (1982). Pollination Ecology of the Spring Wildflower Community of a Temperate Deciduous Forest.
